communication_goal: 提出具体成长问题并确认可执行的练习方法。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Make named learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI marks allowed. Scene: Two adult stick figures seated opposite each other across small rounded meeting table, friendly mentoring conversation. OPEN physical notebook with center fold and two blank pages lies horizontally foreground center, fully visible. Left developer holds pen lifted above one page without covering it, right mentor explains with open palm. Adult proportions, no age or seniority stereotype. No other paper or laptop, no writing.

coverage_review.scope: W074 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

inversion.note: 原图保留；本卡发布用图为原图精确 RGB 反色（黑底白线）。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W074.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：两位成人围桌进行友好指导，中央打开式纸质笔记本有清楚中缝和两页，笔尖仅触页边；导师身份由角色与对白设定，不从外貌判断。建议和能力进步为对白内容。 布局复核：notebook 气泡已避让导师手部，已核对避让手势。
